Class UDPTransmitter2<T,U>

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.common.UDPTransmitter2<T,U>
Type Parameters:
T - One type (class) of object that is to be transmitted.
U - Another type (class) of object that is to be transmitted.
Direct Known Subclasses:
AnimatedAreaDisplayTransmitter, BarChartsTransmitter, LineChartsTransmitter, NeuralNetDisplayTransmitter, ScatterPlotsTransmitter, TimingDiagramsTransmitter
public class UDPTransmitter2<T,U> extends Object
Generic class to transmit objects of two types T and U via the User Datagram Protocol (UDP) to a UDPReceiver. UDPTransmitter2 transmits individual instances of either type T or U to the UDPReceiver via simple datagrams.

  • Constructor Details

    • UDPTransmitter2

      public UDPTransmitter2(int udpPort, boolean logToConsole, String socketName)
      Constructor, which creates the socket
      Parameters:
      udpPort - port to which socket is to transmit
      logToConsole - whether to send all transmit1() logs to console. Note: transmit1() operation can log every object's toString() string to the console. The more frequently log messages are sent to console, the greater the CPU resources are needed. This can cause noticable slowing of the console display and related applications.
      socketName - unique name for this transmitter's socket, e.g. Bar Chart, HTML Display
